| Deploy Endor system and Rebel Landing Site. '''While''' this side up, opponent loses no more than 1 Force from each of your Force drains at Endor locations. '''Flip''' this card if Bunker “blown away” or if, during your move phase, you control three exterior Endor sites (with two Rebel scouts at each). '''Place''' out of play if Endor “blown away.” || Deploy Endor system and Rebel Landing Site.
